label: Dreischulte 36
title: Warfarin with a sulfonamide antibiotic
statement: Patient treated with warfarin - is co-prescribed a sulfonamide

plain_summary: A supply of a sulfonamide antibiotic during warfarin treatment calls for a review of the interaction and the patient's INR monitoring.

medicine_groups.name: Warfarin
medicine_groups.note: Use the dated supply and the current anticoagulation directions.

medicine_groups.name: A sulfonamide antibiotic
medicine_groups.note: Co-trimoxazole contains sulfamethoxazole and trimethoprim. Trimethoprim alone and non-antibiotic sulfonamides do not count.

rule_for_models: Report and cite both supplies when a systemic sulfonamide antibiotic course overlaps warfarin treatment. Use the anticoagulation directions, quantities, treatment dates and recorded holds or stops, including longer supplies dispensed earlier. If either course is unclear but overlap is plausible, cite both supplies as a possible finding and ask the pharmacist to confirm the dates. Documented non-overlap gives no finding. An INR result is not required to identify co-prescribing.
cannot_be_seen: The supplies alone cannot show whether both medicines were taken, how the INR changed, whether bleeding occurred or what monitoring was arranged elsewhere.
ask_the_gp: Could you review the sulfonamide antibiotic and the plan for checking the INR during and after treatment?
